value.name: couple exits theater in silence
value.description: Micky and Charlene leave the movie theater without speaking, establishing an awkward mood after the film.
evidence: After the movie, Micky and Charlene exit the theater. Neither says a word for a moment.

value.name: Charlene mocks Micky's movie choice
value.description: Charlene criticizes the movie Micky chose and questions why he brought her to see it.
evidence: CHARLENE asks, 'That's what you wanted to see? There wasn't even any sex. What Lowell guy on a road crew saw that movie in Lexington and recommended it??'

value.name: Micky panics over missing keys
value.description: Micky rushes toward the car, believes he has lost his keys, and becomes visibly anxious.
evidence: Micky walks quickly ahead to the car, can't find his keys.
MICKY grows anxious, muttering, 'Where's the keys, I musta lost 'em in the theatah, I'm a dummy,' as he turns back toward the theater.

value.name: Charlene points out keys in Micky's hand
value.description: Charlene stops Micky and reveals that the keys are already in his hand, embarrassing him.
evidence: CHARLENE calls out, 'Micky,' and he stops, turns. 'They're in your hand.'
Micky looks down, embarrassed to see the keys clenched in his fist.

value.name: Charlene accuses Micky of hiding a girlfriend
value.description: At the car, Charlene confronts Micky about his behavior and suggests he brought her to Lexington to avoid running into another woman.
evidence: CHARLENE presses, 'What's going on? You afraid to run into your girlfriend? You have a girlfriend, just say it, that's why you took me to Lexington.'

value.name: Micky denies having a girlfriend
value.description: Micky stops the car, turns it off, and insists he came to Lexington because he does not want to be seen in Lowell.
evidence: He suddenly stops, puts the car in park, and turns the engine off.
MICKY insists, 'I don't have a girlfriend. I came here because I don't wanna show my face in Lowell.'

value.name: Micky reveals shame over failed promises
value.description: Micky admits he feels ashamed because he promised to win the fight, get back on track, and move Kasie into a bigger place.
evidence: MICKY grows dark: 'I told everyone I was gonna win that fight and get back on track. I told Kasie we'd get a biggah place so she could move in.'

value.name: Charlene blames family pressure for the fight
value.description: Charlene reminds Micky that he said he never should have fought, but his mother and brother pushed him into it.
evidence: CHARLENE replies, 'You said you never shoulda fought that guy, but your mothah and your brothah wanted ya to do it.'

value.name: Micky feels alone in the ring
value.description: Micky snaps that family pressure does not matter because he is alone when he fights.
evidence: MICKY snaps, 'What's the difference, I'm alone in the ring anyway.'

value.name: Charlene questions family loyalty
value.description: Charlene challenges Micky's belief that his family is looking out for him.
evidence: CHARLENE challenges, 'You think your family's lookin' out for ya?'

value.name: Micky turns toward Charlene's challenge
value.description: Micky begins to respond to Charlene's challenge, indicating the conversation is pushing him to confront his family situation.
